presentationHeadroom.reason: Residents are drawn from their feet and the walkable floor reaches the board's top edge, so with only the centring margin above the board the frame edge cut tall bodies off under the status bar.
presentationHeadroom.rule: The native ranch reserves RAISING_TOP_HEADROOM_NATIVE (tallest main-side body 77, m503/m518, plus the 7-pixel top-edge foot overhang = 84) above the board and takes the largest whole screen-pixel scale at which board and headroom fit; a frame that cannot hold both at two whole pixels keeps two and scrolls vertically. Art, residents, shadows, food, feedback and input share the one placement.
presentationHeadroom.doesNotChange: Movement, terrain, positions, RNG, save data or any gameplay value.

implementation.legacySavePolicy: Preserve existing records; do not silently drop, move or relabel them as original-valid
implementation.presentationPolicy: Keep current shelf layout labelled PRODUCT_AUTHORED until complete compositor, save compatibility and original screen/live trace checks pass

expansionPrototype.rule: One annex deck of ten slots (five columns by two rows) beside the original rank-gated board. Inside the annex every original placement rule holds: the sixteen shape masks, the upper-row rule for two-row shapes (0xaa), one occupancy word per deck, unique module ownership. The annex is not rank-gated and holds no Waiting Room.
expansionPrototype.save: Saved slots 20..29 are annex-local 0..9. cageEdit.layoutVersion NATIVE_DECKS_V1 with cageEdit.expansion {version:1, decks:1, grant:PROTOTYPE_NON_PAID}; a ranch without the grant keeps NATIVE_ANCHORS_V1 byte-for-byte and schemaVersion stays 5. Grant migrates V1 -> DECKS_V1 without touching placements; revoking an empty annex migrates back to the exact V1 record. Mixed or unknown versions are refused, never repaired or reset.
expansionPrototype.field: The annex columns follow the board's unlocked columns on the same field ring (ring slot = unlocked + local), so walking, carrying, spawning, feeding and training run unchanged over a longer ring. Each cage is still its own walkable component, as on the original board; residents reach the annex by being carried, as between any two cages.
expansionPrototype.presentation: The ring is shown folded at the annex seam: band 0 is ring [0, unlocked*48), band 1 the annex, drawn as the honeycomb's next two rows (Owner 2026-10-06: no gap between the hexes). Band 1's top edge is RANCH_ANNEX_BAND_OFFSET_NATIVE (176) native pixels below band 0's top: field tops sit 88 apart, plus the 24-pixel upper-row crop. The 24 cropped pixels of its upper-row cells (RANCH_UPPER_ROW_CAP_NATIVE) are drawn back above it, so their pointed tops interlock with band 0's lower row. Where the bands meet, a point belongs to the nearer cell centre. Same whole-pixel scale; the frame scrolls vertically over both. Cage Edit draws the annex's two rows as the main board's third and fourth rows (88 CSS px below its top, columns aligned).
expansionPrototype.lockedSourcesUnchanged: nativeRaisingGround.js, raisingCageArtPlan.js and ranchSlotGeometry.js are hash-locked by docs/art/contracts/cage/field_cm01_01.v1.json and are not edited; the ring repeats their composition and tests require identical output on every original layout.

ordinaryPlayerPreview.rule: A native ranch without the expansion (NATIVE_ANCHORS_V1) shows the annex's rows 3-4 locked: bays at the granted annex's exact origins, band offset and capped back row, each under the original Lid (field_cm29_01), dimmed, three with padlocks (bays 2, 5, 6, all inside the expansion's ten). Owner 2026-10-12: the covers run under every column of the board (a ring as long as the board's, repeating with its wrap), so panning never opens a hole below the ranch; the front row's last half-bay wraps into the band, never into the player's board. With rows below the board (this preview or a granted annex), the ranch opens with the board right under the HUD; the headroom above it stays one drag away, and a tap on a resident brings its whole body into view. They are presentation only: the walk grid, ring, placements, input mapping and save are unchanged, and nothing can be walked into or placed there.
ordinaryPlayerPreview.entry: A 查看擴充 call to action floats over the visible part of the rows on the ranch (and a tap on the rows opens the same sheet); Cage Edit shows the same locked rows under all ten board columns (twenty bays; the first ten are the expansion and carry the padlocks), labelled 擴充區 · 尚未開放, with a 查看擴充 button. Both open one sheet (the native modal dialog) stating what the expansion adds, the rules it keeps, the unchanged 16-resident limit, and that obtaining it is not available yet; its purchase action is disabled.
ordinaryPlayerPreview.capacityDecision: The 16-resident Home limit stays. It is the original's 16-slot resident pool (save poolSlots 0..15); the expansion adds facility space, so residents spread out and crowd less, without raising the raising-throughput ceiling for competition.
ordinaryPlayerPreview.notShown: Legacy layouts, a granted annex (its real cells show instead), the interactive tutorial, and the ?cageArt= single-field preview.

freePanOwnerAdaptation.rule: Continuous free XY dragging, including diagonals, with a fixed camera orientation. A fitting native board retains its initial centered framing and scale but permits signed vertical translation; bounds retain at least min(board height, 48 native pixels) of ground vertically in view. Non-fitting board vertical limits and horizontal behavior are unchanged. One axis reaching its boundary never locks the other. Art, actors, shadows and hit coordinates share the viewport transform.
freePanOwnerAdaptation.scope: Presentation only; no save, actor motion, rotation, gameplay or new gesture authority.
freePanOwnerAdaptation.validation: Pure viewport and extracted existing presenter moveDrag/finishDrag tests cover 100%/70%, fitting/non-fitting maps, eight directions, coordinate round trips, boundary independence and pointercancel. Existing large product-grid CPU input already supports eight directions; this change is not proof that the reported physical-phone behavior is resolved.

carryEdgePanOwnerAdaptation.request: While carrying a resident toward lower cells, scroll the ranch automatically at all viewport edges and corners. This is not blank-ground map dragging.
carryEdgePanOwnerAdaptation.rule: Use the existing presentation ticker and carried input owner. Add bounded vertical edge movement to existing horizontal auto-scroll at 216 screen px/s, capped to 50ms per tick and 216px/s vector speed at corners. Positive bottom-edge travel subtracts from cameraY to reveal lower cells. Clamp vertical and nonwrapped horizontal axes independently; preserve horizontal wrapping. Reproject the held pointer through the updated shared world transform before updateHand/updateCarry.
carryEdgePanOwnerAdaptation.inputBoundary: Only an active carried resident and a pointer inside the field may scroll. DOM controls above the canvas block edge scrolling. Pointer leave clears the edge point; release, pointercancel, lostpointercapture, screen disposal, blur and context cancellation stop the existing owner. No second ticker or timer.
carryEdgePanOwnerAdaptation.validation: Controlled actual ticker and input-handler execution at 100% and 70%, all eight edge directions, stationary pointer, bounded corners and independent clamps, updated native ground tile at release, UI rejection and cancellation. Physical-phone gesture/drop acceptance remains pending.
carryEdgePanOwnerAdaptation.doesNotChange: Native actor carry/flight/terrain/save rules, manual free pan, camera orientation, map pixel scale, or floor/depth rendering.
